school_name: The University of Texas at San Antonio
title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten named UTSA Libraries study environments, spanning quiet work, computer use, collaboration, and reservable rooms at the John Peace Library.

cards.title: Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: John Peace Library, second floor
cards.notes: Bring a focused reading or writing task and keep conversation outside; UTSA designates this second-floor room for quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet room on JPL’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UTSA Libraries lists Quiet Study (2.01.34) among its John Peace Library quiet-study options.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Space | UTSA Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in John Peace Library; follow the library’s quiet-space policy.

cards.title: Quiet Computing
cards.subtitle: John Peace Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use a library workstation or settle in with your own laptop, and mute audio before entering this designated quiet-computing room.
cards.short_summary: A computer-focused quiet area on JPL’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UTSA Libraries identifies Quiet Computing (2.01.30) as a second-floor quiet-study option at JPL.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Space | UTSA Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in John Peace Library; use headphones and keep audio muted.

cards.title: Quiet Spot
cards.subtitle: John Peace Library, third floor
cards.notes: Choose this third-floor quiet area for solo reading or drafting, and plan to keep calls and group discussion elsewhere in JPL.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet-study option on JPL’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UTSA Libraries lists Quiet Spot (3.02.34) among the quiet-study spaces on JPL’s third floor.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Space | UTSA Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in John Peace Library; follow posted quiet-area expectations.

cards.title: Quiet Computing Room
cards.subtitle: John Peace Library, third floor
cards.notes: Plan a short individual computer session here; the library map identifies this quiet-computing room as a four-seat space.
cards.evidence_claim: UTSA Libraries lists Quiet Computing Room (3.03.02) as a four-seat quiet-study option.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Space | UTSA Libraries
cards.access_notes: Four seats are identified by UTSA Libraries; use it as a quiet area.

cards.title: Quiet Zone Study Tables
cards.subtitle: John Peace Library, third floor
cards.notes: Set up at a designated third-floor table when you need sustained solo work, then keep devices and conversation low-key.
cards.short_summary: Designated quiet study tables on JPL’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UTSA Libraries lists Quiet Zone study tables among the quiet-study options on JPL’s third floor.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Space | UTSA Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in John Peace Library and subject to the library quiet-space policy.

cards.title: Graduate Quiet Study Room
cards.subtitle: John Peace Library, third floor
cards.notes: Graduate students can use this dedicated quiet room for concentrated reading, analysis, or writing; verify eligibility before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated graduate quiet-study room in JPL.
cards.evidence_claim: UTSA Libraries lists Graduate Quiet Study Room (3.03.56) among its JPL quiet-study spaces.
cards.source_title: Find a Study Space | UTSA Libraries
cards.access_notes: Named as a graduate quiet-study room; confirm current eligibility or access at the library.

cards.title: GroupSpot
cards.subtitle: John Peace Library, second floor near the Information Desk
cards.notes: Meet collaborators at the shared tables and displays, then check the room’s current availability because it may also host classes or programs.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped JPL space for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: UTSA Libraries describes GroupSpot as a second-floor JPL collaborative study space with small-group tables, laptops, and shared displays.
cards.source_title: UTSA Libraries opens GroupSpot | UTSA Libraries
cards.access_notes: Near the JPL Information Desk; availability can vary when the room is used for instruction or programs.

cards.title: TeamSpace
cards.subtitle: John Peace Library, third floor
cards.notes: Use the four collaborative tables to compare drafts or work through a project together, while keeping voices low for nearby library users.
cards.short_summary: A compact collaborative study area in JPL.
cards.evidence_claim: UTSA Libraries’ John Peace Library self-guided tour identifies TeamSpace as a third-floor area with four collaborative study tables.
cards.source_title: John Peace Library – Self Guided Tour
cards.access_notes: Located on JPL’s third floor; library policy asks users in collaborative areas to keep noise low.

cards.title: 4th Floor Study
cards.subtitle: John Peace Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Work near the microforms and government documents area when you need a defined fourth-floor place to read, research, or organize notes.
cards.short_summary: A named JPL study area beside research collections.
cards.evidence_claim: UTSA Libraries’ self-guided tour identifies 4th Floor Study as a study area that also houses microforms and government documents.
cards.source_title: John Peace Library – Self Guided Tour
cards.access_notes: Located on JPL’s fourth floor, near microforms and government documents.

cards.title: 4th Floor Commons
cards.subtitle: John Peace Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Choose a workstation or study carrel for independent computer work, and keep this shared commons comfortable for other library users.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor mix of computer workstations and study carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: UTSA Libraries’ self-guided tour describes 4th Floor Commons as having computer workstations and study carrels.
cards.source_title: John Peace Library – Self Guided Tour
cards.access_notes: Located on the fourth floor of John Peace Library.
